title: The Silver Trumpets

questions.question: How many silver trumpets were made?
Who was allowed to blow the trumpets?
options: The sons of Aaron, the priests
questions.correctAnswer: The sons of Aaron, the priests
questions.explanation: Numbers 10:8 (ESV): "The sons of Aaron, the priests, shall blow the trumpets."

questions.question: What happened when both trumpets were blown?
questions.explanation: Numbers 10:3 (ESV): "And when they blow them, all the congregation shall gather..."

questions.question: When did the cloud lift from over the tabernacle to start the journey?
options: In the second year, in the second month, on the twentieth day
questions.correctAnswer: In the second year, in the second month, on the twentieth day
questions.explanation: Numbers 10:11 (ESV): "In the second year, in the second month, on the twentieth day... the cloud lifted."

questions.question: Which camp set out first?
questions.explanation: Numbers 10:14 (ESV): "The standard of the camp of the people of Judah set out first..."

questions.question: Who was Hobab?
options: The son of Reuel the Midianite, Moses' father-in-law
questions.correctAnswer: The son of Reuel the Midianite, Moses' father-in-law
questions.explanation: Numbers 10:29 (ESV): "Moses said to Hobab the son of Reuel the Midianite, Moses' father-in-law..."

questions.question: What did Moses ask Hobab to do?
options: Come with them and be their eyes
questions.correctAnswer: Come with them and be their eyes
questions.explanation: Numbers 10:31 (ESV): "Do not leave us... you will know where we shall camp... and you will be to us as eyes."

questions.question: What signaled the camps on the east to set out?
questions.explanation: Numbers 10:5 (ESV): "When you blow an alarm, the camps that are on the east side shall set out."

questions.question: What signaled the camps on the south to set out?
questions.explanation: Numbers 10:6 (ESV): "And when you blow an alarm the second time, the camps that are on the south side shall set out."

questions.question: What chant did Moses say when the ark set out?
options: Arise, O Lord, and let your enemies be scattered
questions.correctAnswer: Arise, O Lord, and let your enemies be scattered
questions.explanation: Numbers 10:35 (ESV): "Arise, O Lord, and let your enemies be scattered, and let those who hate you flee before you."

questions.question: What chant did Moses say when the ark rested?
options: Return, O Lord, to the ten thousand thousands of Israel
questions.correctAnswer: Return, O Lord, to the ten thousand thousands of Israel
questions.explanation: Numbers 10:36 (ESV): "Return, O Lord, to the ten thousand thousands of Israel."

questions.question: Who carried the tabernacle (tent curtains etc.)?
questions.explanation: Numbers 10:17 (ESV): "And the sons of Gershon and the sons of Merari, who carried the tabernacle, set out."

questions.question: When did the Kohathites set out carrying the holy things?
questions.explanation: Numbers 10:21 (ESV): "Then the Kohathites set out... and the tabernacle was set up before they arrived."

questions.question: For what purpose other than moving were the trumpets used?
options: In the day of gladness, feasts, and beginning of months over burnt offerings
questions.correctAnswer: In the day of gladness, feasts, and beginning of months over burnt offerings
questions.explanation: Numbers 10:10 (ESV): "On the day of your gladness also... and at the beginnings of your months, you shall blow the trumpets over your burnt offerings..."

questions.question: What craftsmanship was used for the trumpets?
questions.explanation: Numbers 10:2 (ESV): "Of hammered work you shall make them."

key_verse_text: And whenever the ark set out, Moses said, 'Arise, O Lord, and let your enemies be scattered, and let those who hate you flee before you.'
